creative_direction.audience: a senior cafe brand art director and a lifestyle content editor
creative_direction.desired_response: a quiet white frame that still feels located inside a real room
creative_direction.art_direction: an overhead Instagram cafe photograph whose depth comes from the raised round table, receding tile and partial off-frame shadows
creative_direction.restraint: one product, one round table, one floor wedge and one window-light idea

reference_binding.runtime_role: offline camera, composition, support-surface, lighting and optional declared cup-design contract

camera_geometry.projection: rectilinear overhead projection with slight real perspective
camera_geometry.distortion: no ultra-wide edge stretch or perfectly orthographic diagram
camera_geometry.depth_of_field: product, curved table edge and nearby floor cues remain readable without portrait masking

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: single overhead product slot envelope including a visible handle only in adopt-reference mode
composition_geometry.negative_space: 70-80 percent meaningful table-and-floor environment around one complete product

support_plane.kind: large matte white circular tabletop above a gray tiled floor
support_plane.perspective: curved raised table edge on the left and receding tile grout visible beyond it

composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: large quiet white field counterweighted by a narrow gray floor wedge and one just-below-center product
composition_geometry.crop_policy: retain the complete product, full adopted handle when applicable, attached shadow, curved table edge and at least two receding floor-grout segments

composition_variation.selection: choose a deterministic small product offset and new broad environmental-shadow arrangement from the request seed
composition_variation.repeat_guard: adjacent outputs may not share both identical product position and identical broad environmental-shadow arrangement

lighting_geometry.source_topology: one large upper-left window plus weak neutral room bounce and partial off-frame occlusion
lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: broad protected white and container highlights with no clipped patch
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: transparent source containers retain rim thickness, refraction and a faint physically connected transmitted lift

tone_signature.white_point: warm-neutral textured white, never broad pure white
tone_signature.contrast_curve: gentle toe, readable plane separation and soft highlight shoulder
tone_signature.saturation: low globally while preserving source product color
tone_signature.shadow_color: quiet neutral to faintly cool gray
tone_signature.material_separation: product, table and floor remain distinct without local-contrast exaggeration
tone_signature.local_contrast: moderate only at product rim, beverage details, table edge and floor grout

finish_signature.acuity: finite social-photo acuity with identity details readable and no uniform tack sharpness
finish_signature.microcontrast: restrained outside product rim, table edge and floor grout
finish_signature.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression
finish_signature.depth_rendering: geometry, edge height, grout convergence and light falloff before softness
finish_signature.retouching: materially honest, retaining slight table, floor and drink irregularity

hard_fail: left gray floor wedge or receding grout absent
broad off-frame environmental shadow atmosphere absent
fabric, coaster, napkin, saucer or prop present
reference coffee or latte art copied
product inherits an oblique source camera or exposes excessive cup sidewall
beverage color or syrup appears on an opaque cup exterior or base
